sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register data sets
Reporting codes list: pollution inventory reporting

examples.input_condition: Installation is present but a pollutant row is absent
examples.expected_parser_action: Preserve ABSENT_OR_BELOW_THRESHOLD; do not emit numeric zero

examples.input_condition: Source method is M or an M_* detailed code
examples.expected_parser_action: Store measured category and detailed method separately

examples.input_condition: 30 percent measured, 15 percent estimated, 55 percent calculated
examples.expected_parser_action: Select C as the dominant annual method while retaining component provenance

examples.input_condition: Positive calculated result is below the reporting threshold
examples.expected_parser_action: Store BRT or the actual positive value; never coerce to zero

examples.input_condition: Best information indicates substance is not released
examples.expected_parser_action: Store NOT_APPLICABLE rather than zero or BRT

examples.input_condition: No more than 5 percent positive readings and positives are no more than 20 percent above LOD
examples.expected_parser_action: Permit all readings to be treated as below LOD under documented rule

examples.input_condition: LOD sparse-positive exception does not apply
examples.expected_parser_action: Use measured positives and half-LOD for non-detects only with flow-period data

examples.input_condition: Newly permitted site operated for part of the reporting year
examples.expected_parser_action: Retain operating-period scope and do not automatically annualise

examples.input_condition: Permit transferred during the reporting year
examples.expected_parser_action: Associate whole-year return with the new permit reference while preserving transfer metadata

examples.input_condition: Facility emission row lacks a valid grid reference
examples.expected_parser_action: Reject spatial-candidate status until a valid coordinate exists

examples.input_condition: Point-source rows cover only part of a sector total
examples.expected_parser_action: Keep residual area emissions separate from installation rows

examples.input_condition: Registry/account report contains verified emissions, surrendered allowances and free allocation
examples.expected_parser_action: Store each measure in a distinct field and require independent geometry before parcel binding
examples.risk_prevented: Allowance-as-emission substitution and account-to-parcel false match
